Real-world perception and debugging: metal surface crack detection with wavelet denoising, autonomous driving with 30 vehicles+10 pedestrians (zero collisions), resolved 11 COFFIN integration failures (false positives, servo brownout, frame capture)

llm_analysis.reasoning: Justin has strong computer vision, object detection, and production perception deployment skills backed by multiple capstone and industry projects. Sensor fusion experience exists but is limited to vision+ToF, not the full maritime sensor suite Saildrone emphasizes. State estimation theory is a gap—his tracking is empirical (YOLO frame-to-frame), not probabilistic. These gaps are real but not disqualifying if he learns LiDAR/radar APIs quickly and formalizes state estimation during onboarding. Role aligns with robotics+perception foundation; risk is sensor modality narrowness and theory depth.
